name: Linear supply and demand with a demand shift
description: A textbook linear supply and demand system solved for the clearing price each year, with an exogenous demand-shift input rising over 2026-2030. Demonstrates the engine's scalar equilibrium (solve) block: price is not computed by an equation, it is the root the engine finds each step.
scope: Toy linear market. The intercepts and slopes are round guesses, not calibrated to any commodity or labor market; only the mechanism (an exogenous shock shifting demand and moving the clearing price) is meant to generalize.

variables.description: Quantity supplied at the clearing price
Quantity demanded at the clearing price, shifted by the exogenous input

solves.description: Find the price where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied

tests.name: 2030: supply equals demand after the shift
2030: price is higher once demand has shifted up
